newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close mixed in continuous trade.

text.p: Seven stocks rose, five fell and eight were flat in 5.4-million-zloty Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Monday with the WIG 20 index down 0.6 percent to 1,472.8 points.
The remaining 10 stocks did not trade.
NFI units fell 0.4 percent to 121 zlotys in a 3.6-million-zloty turnover.
Three National Investment Funds (NFIs) fell, one rose and 11 were flat in 4.6-million-zloty trade.
